note: Claiborne Parish (FIPS 22027): no parish zoning layer found in ArcGIS Hub/Online or via web search; parish portal (claiborneone.org) and GIS pages show no zoning service. The town of Homer publishes its zoning only as a 1959 PDF zoning map and PDF zoning text (Appendix A), not a queryable polygon service. Haynesville and other towns show no published zoning GIS. No ArcGIS REST zoning district layer exists for the county or its cities.
